scope: Provider request formatting and concurrent refusal protection in application code. HTTP transport and phone provider are simulated; no real call or production certification.
fixes: Send a complete Romanian destination in international +40 format to the documented POST /call endpoint; retain the original CRM snapshot.
Reject incomplete or unsupported numbers before provider HTTP and before creating a CRM call document.
Creating a call no longer writes aiDoNotCall=false, preserving a refusal recorded after the initial eligibility check.
The dispatch transaction cancels a refused call with owner_do_not_call without invoking the provider or clearing the refusal.

validation.raceEvidence: The HTTP-route test writes a refusal through getAgentName after eligibility validation and before owner-status update, then verifies persisted refusal, canceled call, absent dispatch timestamp and zero provider calls.

limitations: Full natural-language launch, approval UI, live provider readiness and external conversation result remain uncertified.
This does not retract requests already dispatched or accepted by the provider.
The original-scenario local real-model count remains 108/1000; there are zero complete production certifications.
